descripcion: Where you get things done: town hall and public counter, police station, bank, post office, court, church and other places of worship, funeral home and cemetery, hairdresser's, launderette and local services.

mostrador_atencion_puestos.descripcion: Long chest-high counter split into service points by thin screens sticking out towards you. Follow it with your hand and count the screens to find your point.
mostrador_atencion_puestos.imagen: Footprint of “Public counter with service points”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

puesto_atencion_sentado.nombre: Seated service desk with accessible section
puesto_atencion_sentado.descripcion: Low service desk where you sit facing the clerk. One section is clear underneath for a wheelchair; a wing with the computer sticks out on the other side.
puesto_atencion_sentado.imagen: Footprint of “Seated service desk with accessible section”: an L shape, 1.80 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

ventanilla_cristal.descripcion: A window closed by glass right to the top. You speak through a grille at mouth height and papers go through a tray sunk into the ledge at waist height.
ventanilla_cristal.imagen: Footprint of “Glazed window with document tray”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Vc”.

mostrador_denuncias.descripcion: Tall L-shaped desk with a security screen on top and a gap to speak through. The duty officer sits behind; the short arm reaches the wall.
mostrador_denuncias.imagen: Footprint of “Police station front desk”: an L shape, 2.40 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Md”.

cabina_atencion.descripcion: A small room of panels and glass, with a door, where one person is seen in private. Inside are a desk and two chairs; outside voices fade when the door shuts.
cabina_atencion.imagen: Footprint of “Private interview booth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

puesto_huellas_dni.nombre: ID card fingerprint and photo desk
puesto_huellas_dni.descripcion: Service desk with a mouse-sized fingerprint reader on the top and a pad to sign on. It beeps when you put your finger on it.

acciones.poner_huella: Put your finger on the reader

puesto_huellas_dni.imagen: Footprint of “ID card fingerprint and photo desk”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

gestor_turnos.nombre: Queue kiosk with ticket and voice
gestor_turnos.descripcion: A column with a sloping screen at chest height and big buttons. Press and a ticket comes out below while a voice says your number. Usually just inside the door.
gestor_turnos.imagen: Footprint of “Queue kiosk with ticket and voice”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Gt”.

bancada_espera_chapa.descripcion: A row of cold, hard perforated steel seats on a beam with two feet. There is an armrest between seats; sometimes a small table at one end.
bancada_espera_chapa.imagen: Footprint of “Perforated steel waiting bench”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.68 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

banco_espera_anclado.descripcion: A steel bench with no back or arms, bolted to the floor: it does not budge however you push. Knee high.
banco_espera_anclado.imagen: Footprint of “Floor-fixed waiting bench”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

linea_espera_suelo.descripcion: A strip stuck to the floor a couple of steps from the counter: wait there to give the person ahead some privacy. It is slightly raised; you feel it with foot or cane.
linea_espera_suelo.aviso: Waiting line: wait here for your turn.
linea_espera_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Wait-here floor line”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Le”.

mesa_impresos.descripcion: A tall, narrow table for writing standing up, with pens on little chains and a sloping rack of forms at the back.
mesa_impresos.imagen: Footprint of “Stand-up form-filling table”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

expositor_formularios.descripcion: A rack of sloping trays hung on the wall from chest to head height, one kind of form in each slot. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane passes under it.
expositor_formularios.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted form rack”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.15 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ef”.

maquina_certificados.descripcion: A metal cabinet with a screen, a card reader and a slot at waist height where the printed sheet comes out. It hums slightly and beeps at each key.
maquina_certificados.imagen: Footprint of “Self-service certificate machine”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

fotomaton.descripcion: A sheet-metal booth with a short curtain across the entrance. Inside is a round stool that goes up and down as you spin it; photos come out of a slot outside at waist height.
fotomaton.imagen: Footprint of “Photo booth with curtain”: a box with the curtained entrance at the front left and the machine on the right, 1.60 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Fo”.

buzon_sugerencias.descripcion: A box with a slot on top, on a thin stand at chest height, with a pad of slips and a pen on a string. Push it and it wobbles.
buzon_sugerencias.imagen: Footprint of “Suggestion box on a stand”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

directorio_plantas.descripcion: A wide sloping lectern on two legs at waist height, listing floors and services in raised print and braille. It stands by the entrance or the lifts.
directorio_plantas.imagen: Footprint of “Floor directory lectern”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.90 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Dp”.

mastiles_banderas.descripcion: Three slim poles on heavy bases in a row against the wall. The flags hang limp and brush your shoulder before the cane finds the base.
mastiles_banderas.imagen: Footprint of “Lobby flagpoles”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 1.40 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

vitrina_edictos.descripcion: A flat case with locked glass doors, hung on the wall from chest height up, where official notices are posted. It sticks out only a little, but the cane misses it.
vitrina_edictos.imagen: Footprint of “Glazed official notice case”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ve”.

mesa_electoral_urna.descripcion: A long table with a hard plastic ballot box on it, the size of a fruit crate, with a slot in the lid. The three polling officers sit behind.
mesa_electoral_urna.imagen: Footprint of “Polling table with ballot box”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

cabina_votacion.descripcion: A tube frame with curtains on three sides and a shelf of ballot papers inside. It is light: lean on it and it shifts.
cabina_votacion.imagen: Footprint of “Voting booth”: a U open at the front, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

escaner_bolsos.descripcion: A chest-high metal tunnel with a belt running through it non-stop. Put your bag on one end; it goes in through rubber flaps and comes out on the other side.
escaner_bolsos.imagen: Footprint of “Bag X-ray scanner with belt”: a wide body in the middle with a narrower belt sticking out at both sides, 2.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

mesa_bandejas_control.descripcion: A steel table with a stack of plastic trays: leave keys, phone and belt there before walking through the arch. The trays slide and sound hollow.
mesa_bandejas_control.imagen: Footprint of “Security tray table”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

garita_seguridad.descripcion: A small glass-and-metal booth for the guard, with a sliding hatch at chest height. A radio or intercom sounds inside.
garita_seguridad.imagen: Footprint of “Security booth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gs”.

puesto_caja_banco.descripcion: A chest-high teller counter with a glass screen on top and a sunken tray where money and papers pass. Drawers and a note counter sound behind it.
puesto_caja_banco.imagen: Footprint of “Bank teller position with screen”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

mesa_gestor_banco.nombre: Bank adviser's desk with visitor chairs
mesa_gestor_banco.descripcion: An office desk with two client chairs right in front. There is often a low screen between desks; the chairs move and are hardly ever straight.
mesa_gestor_banco.imagen: Footprint of “Bank adviser's desk with visitor chairs”: a wide top at the back and two chairs sticking out to the front, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mg”.

atril_bienvenida_banco.descripcion: A small rounded stand-up desk just inside the door, where a member of staff asks what you need and sends you to the queue or to a desk.
atril_bienvenida_banco.imagen: Footprint of “Bank greeter desk”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.90 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

bateria_cajeros.descripcion: Several cash machines set in a row in one wall, separated by privacy fins sticking out a hand and a half. Each beeps differently when you press its keys.
bateria_cajeros.imagen: Footprint of “Row of lobby cash machines”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

cajero_adaptado_voz.nombre: Low accessible cash machine with voice guidance
cajero_adaptado_voz.descripcion: A cash machine lower than the rest, with knee space underneath, a keypad with the dot on the five and a headphone socket: plug in and a voice guides you step by step.
cajero_adaptado_voz.imagen: Footprint of “Low accessible cash machine with voice guidance”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

actualizador_libretas.descripcion: A narrow machine with a horizontal slot at chest height. Push the open passbook in, hear the printer run back and forth, and it hands it back.
actualizador_libretas.imagen: Footprint of “Passbook update machine”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Al”.

buzon_ingresos.descripcion: A steel mouth set in the wall at chest height with a tilting flap: drop the envelope of cash in and it falls inside with a thud.
buzon_ingresos.imagen: Footprint of “Night deposit box”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bi”.

maquina_ingreso_monedas.descripcion: A machine with a deep tray at waist height where you tip your coins. It swallows them with a clatter of change and prints a receipt.
maquina_ingreso_monedas.imagen: Footprint of “Coin deposit machine”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.60 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

esclusa_seguridad.descripcion: A round glass cabin with two curved doors that never open together. Press the button, the lock buzzes, step in, it closes behind you and a voice tells you to go through. Room for one person only.
esclusa_seguridad.aviso: Interlock: press the button, step in and wait for the second door to open.
esclusa_seguridad.imagen: Footprint of “Security interlock door”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

caja_fuerte_banco.descripcion: A solid steel cabinet taller than a person, with a combination dial and a handwheel. It does not ring hollow when struck: it is a solid block.
caja_fuerte_banco.imagen: Footprint of “Large bank safe”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

cajas_alquiler.descripcion: A whole wall of little steel doors, each with two locks. Behind each door is a long drawer you pull out by a handle.
cajas_alquiler.imagen: Footprint of “Safe deposit boxes”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

mostrador_correos.descripcion: A waist-high counter with a lowered section holding the scales: rest the parcel there, it beeps as it is weighed and the clerk stamps it.
mostrador_correos.imagen: Footprint of “Post office counter with scales”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

apartados_correos.descripcion: A wall of small metal lockers with raised numbers, each with its own lock. The little doors sound like thin sheet metal.
apartados_correos.imagen: Footprint of “PO box lockers”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

buzon_correos_interior.descripcion: A square sheet-metal unit with two wide mouths at chest height, one for local post and one for everywhere else. The flaps tilt inwards.
buzon_correos_interior.imagen: Footprint of “Indoor post office letterbox”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

mesa_embalaje.descripcion: A tall table for packing parcels standing up, with a tape dispenser bolted to the edge and pens on strings. The tape screeches as you pull it.
mesa_embalaje.imagen: Footprint of “Packing table with tape”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

expositor_embalajes.descripcion: An open rack with flat-packed cardboard boxes standing by size and padded envelopes in trays. The bottom sticks out further than the top.
expositor_embalajes.imagen: Footprint of “Envelope and box display”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.00 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ee”.

taquilla_paqueteria.descripcion: A block of sheet-metal doors of several sizes with a screen and scanner in the middle. Scan the code, it beeps, and one door springs open with a clack.
taquilla_paqueteria.imagen: Footprint of “Smart parcel locker”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

carro_cartero.descripcion: A tall two-wheeled trolley with a big canvas bag and a handle, like a shopping trolley but sturdier. The postman leaves it in a doorway or in the middle of the pavement.
carro_cartero.imagen: Footprint of “Postal delivery trolley”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

saca_correo.descripcion: A big canvas sack full of letters and parcels, sealed with a tag, left on the floor. Soft on top and heavy: your foot will not shift it.
saca_correo.imagen: Footprint of “Mail sack”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

estrado_juez.descripcion: A very long desk on a platform one or two steps up, with a solid wooden front down to the floor. From below it is chest high; at the far end of the room, in the middle.
estrado_juez.imagen: Footprint of “Judge's bench”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ej”.

mesa_letrados.descripcion: A long table with a wooden modesty panel in front, set sideways on each flank of the bench: the lawyers sit behind it, facing the middle of the room.
mesa_letrados.imagen: Footprint of “Counsel table”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ml”.

mesa_secretario_judicial.descripcion: An L-shaped desk at the foot of the bench with the computer and the recording equipment. You hear typing all through the hearing: it tells you where the front of the room is.
mesa_secretario_judicial.imagen: Footprint of “Court clerk's desk”: an L shape, 1.60 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ms”.

estrado_testigo.descripcion: A waist-high wooden rail in a U, open at the back to step in, with a microphone on a flexible arm. You give evidence standing, holding it, facing the bench.
estrado_testigo.imagen: Footprint of “Witness stand with microphone”: a U open at the back, 0.90 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Et”.

banquillo_acusados.descripcion: A short wooden bench without arms, alone in the middle of the room facing the judge. Nothing in front or beside it: you reach it across open floor.
banquillo_acusados.imagen: Footprint of “Dock bench”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

cabina_acusados_blindada.descripcion: An enclosure of thick glass up to the ceiling, with benches inside and a side door. Voices from inside come over a loudspeaker; outside it is a smooth, cold wall.
cabina_acusados_blindada.imagen: Footprint of “Glazed secure dock”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

barandilla_publico.descripcion: A waist-high wooden rail across the room separating the public from the court. In the middle is a small swing gate that closes by itself.
barandilla_publico.imagen: Footprint of “Public bar with gate”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

banco_publico_sala.descripcion: A long wooden bench with a straight back and no cushion, in rows behind the rail. It creaks when you sit and echoes round the room.
banco_publico_sala.imagen: Footprint of “Courtroom public bench”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

cabina_interprete.descripcion: A soundproof booth with a big window in front and a door behind. Inside is a narrow desk with microphones and headphones; shut the door and the room goes silent.
cabina_interprete.imagen: Footprint of “Interpreter's booth”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.70 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ci”.

carro_expedientes.descripcion: A two-shelf metal trolley on four wheels, loaded with folders tied with tape. Staff leave it in the court corridors, in front of any door.
carro_expedientes.imagen: Footprint of “Case file trolley”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

escanos_plenos.descripcion: A curved bank of desks with their seats behind, in a half-moon facing the chair. From the front it is a continuous wooden face at waist height; each place has a microphone.
escanos_plenos.imagen: Footprint of “Curved council chamber seats”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 5.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

tribuna_oradores.descripcion: A big enclosed lectern, wider at the front, on a step. You climb in from behind; at the top are a sloping shelf and two microphones.
tribuna_oradores.imagen: Footprint of “Speaker's rostrum”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

mesa_presidencia_pleno.nombre: Chair's table on a curved dais
mesa_presidencia_pleno.descripcion: A one-step half-moon platform with a long table and high-backed chairs on it. The curved edge of the platform is the first thing the cane finds.
mesa_presidencia_pleno.imagen: Footprint of “Chair's table on a curved dais”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 4.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

banco_iglesia.descripcion: A long wooden bench with a straight back and, in front, a low kneeling board. They stand in rows facing the altar: follow the centre aisle by touching their ends.
banco_iglesia.imagen: Footprint of “Church pew with kneeler”: a long seat at the back and a kneeling board in front, joined at one end, 2.50 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Bi”.

reclinatorio_individual.descripcion: A small piece for kneeling: a padded board almost at floor level and, in front, an elbow rest at waist height. It is light and it moves.
reclinatorio_individual.imagen: Footprint of “Single prie-dieu”: a T shape, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ri”.

filas_sillas_unidas_templo.descripcion: Upholstered chairs hooked together by the legs in a straight row. No kneeler; the whole row shifts if you push one end.
filas_sillas_unidas_templo.imagen: Footprint of “Linked rows of chapel chairs”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Fs”.

silleria_coro.descripcion: Carved wooden seats joined in a U against the walls, with very high backs and arms between them. The seats tip up on hinges and drop with a bang.
silleria_coro.imagen: Footprint of “Choir stalls”: a U open at the front, 5.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

gradas_presbiterio.descripcion: Two or three wide steps right across the nave leading up to the altar. No handrail: the cane finds them just where the pews end.
gradas_presbiterio.aviso: Sanctuary steps: they go up towards the altar.
gradas_presbiterio.imagen: Footprint of “Sanctuary steps”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

altar_mayor.descripcion: A solid stone or wooden table at waist height, covered with a cloth hanging down the sides. It stands alone in the middle of the sanctuary and you can walk round it.
altar_mayor.imagen: Footprint of “Church altar”: a rectangle, 2.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

ambon.descripcion: A solid stone or wooden lectern, wider at the base, with a sloping top and a microphone. It stands to one side of the altar, at the edge of the steps.
ambon.imagen: Footprint of “Ambo”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

sede_celebrante.descripcion: A big wooden chair with a high back and arms, with a stool on either side. It stands against the back wall or beside the altar, facing the pews.
sede_celebrante.imagen: Footprint of “Celebrant's chair”: a T shape, 1.80 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

sagrario.descripcion: A box of worked metal with a small locked door, on a pillar or stone shelf at chest height. A small lamp always burns beside it.
sagrario.imagen: Footprint of “Tabernacle on a pillar”: an octagon, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

cirio_pascual.descripcion: A thick, very tall candle on a metal stand with a wide foot, beside the ambo or the font. Knock it and it sways; there is a flame at the top.
cirio_pascual.imagen: Footprint of “Paschal candle on its stand”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

comulgatorio.descripcion: A low stone or wrought-iron rail closing off the sanctuary from side to side, with a padded step outside for kneeling and a little gate in the middle.
comulgatorio.imagen: Footprint of “Communion rail”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

pulpito_escalera.descripcion: A many-sided box raised against a pillar, reached by a narrow curving stair. It is hollow underneath: the cane goes in and your head meets the floor of the box.
pulpito_escalera.aviso: Pulpit: mind your head, it overhangs at mid height.
pulpito_escalera.imagen: Footprint of “Pulpit with stair”: a many-sided box at the front with a narrow stair reaching it from the back, 1.50 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

pila_bautismal.descripcion: A big eight-sided stone bowl on a thick stem at waist height, with water in it. The rim is broad and cold; usually near the entrance or in a chapel.
pila_bautismal.imagen: Footprint of “Baptismal font”: an octagon, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

pila_agua_bendita.descripcion: A stone shell the size of a soup plate jutting from the wall or a pillar at chest height, by the door. It has no stem: the cane does not find it.
pila_agua_bendita.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted holy water stoup”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

confesionario.descripcion: A wooden booth with a small door or curtain in the middle and, on each side, a recess with a kneeling board and a grille at face height. It stands against the side wall.
confesionario.imagen: Footprint of “Confessional”: a booth in the middle with a lower wing on each side, 2.00 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

lampadario_velas.descripcion: A tiered iron tray at waist height full of lit candles, with a coin box. You feel the heat on your face before you touch it and it smells of wax: keep your hand off the top.
lampadario_velas.imagen: Footprint of “Votive candle stand”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Lv”.

cepillo_limosnas.descripcion: A narrow iron pillar or a wooden box fixed to the wall, with a slot on top. Coins drop and ring inside.
cepillo_limosnas.imagen: Footprint of “Alms box”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

imagen_peana.descripcion: A wooden statue dressed in cloth, on a waist-high wooden plinth. The folds of the mantle and the hands reach out past the plinth at face height.
imagen_peana.imagen: Footprint of “Statue on a plinth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ip”.

verja_capilla.descripcion: A tall wrought-iron screen closing off a side chapel, with a double gate in the middle. Hand and voice pass between the bars; the gate squeals.
verja_capilla.imagen: Footprint of “Chapel screen”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Vc”.

lapida_suelo.nombre: Ledger stone in the church floor
lapida_suelo.descripcion: A stone slab carved with letters and a coat of arms, flush with the nave floor. You walk on it: you feel the relief underfoot and your step sounds different.
lapida_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Ledger stone in the church floor”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ls”.

paso_procesional.descripcion: A big platform of wood and silver carrying statues, resting on trestles and skirted in velvet to the floor. The carrying poles stick out at the ends at shoulder height.
paso_procesional.imagen: Footprint of “Processional float on trestles”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.40 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

organo_tubos.descripcion: A huge case with a front of metal pipes up to the ceiling and, before it, the console with keyboards and a bench. When it plays it fills the whole nave: it tells you where the choir is.
organo_tubos.imagen: Footprint of “Church organ”: a T shape, 3.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ot”.

armonio.descripcion: A small bellows organ like a low, short piano, with two broad pedals you tread to give it air. It stands by the altar in churches with no big organ.
armonio.imagen: Footprint of “Harmonium”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

facistol.descripcion: A giant lectern with four sloping faces on a stem, turning on its axis, for the big choir books. Its corners are at chest height.
facistol.imagen: Footprint of “Choir lectern”: a diamond, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Fa”.

cuerda_campana.descripcion: A thick rope coming down through a hole in the ceiling and ending in a knot at chest height, at the foot of the tower. The cane passes under it; pull and the bell rings above.
cuerda_campana.imagen: Footprint of “Bell rope”: a circle, 0.08 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

alfombras_oracion.descripcion: A whole floor of soft carpet with bands marking the rows. You walk on it barefoot: footsteps go silent the moment you step on.
alfombras_oracion.imagen: Footprint of “Mosque prayer carpet”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ao”.

mueble_calzado_mezquita.nombre: Shoe rack at the prayer hall entrance
mueble_calzado_mezquita.descripcion: An open wooden pigeonhole unit from floor to chest, with holes the size of a pair of shoes. It stands by the prayer hall door; loose shoes often lie on the floor in front.
mueble_calzado_mezquita.imagen: Footprint of “Shoe rack at the prayer hall entrance”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

fuente_abluciones.descripcion: A row of low taps over a stone channel, with a small block in front of each to sit and wash your feet. The floor around is wet and you hear running water.
fuente_abluciones.imagen: Footprint of “Ablution fountain”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.40 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Fa”.

mimbar.descripcion: A straight, narrow wooden stair with side rails rising to a small seat. It stands against the far wall; from the side it is a smooth wedge-shaped wall.
mimbar.imagen: Footprint of “Minbar”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

bima.descripcion: A raised platform a couple of steps up in the middle of the synagogue, ringed by a rail, with a big sloping table where the scroll is read. You climb it from the sides.
bima.imagen: Footprint of “Bimah”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bi”.

atril_metacrilato_templo.descripcion: An acrylic lectern: a smooth, cold sheet bent into a stand with a sloping top. It is light and nearly invisible; struck, it sounds like hard plastic.
atril_metacrilato_templo.imagen: Footprint of “Clear acrylic preaching lectern”: a house-shaped pentagon, 0.60 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

sofas_velatorio.descripcion: Low, soft sofas joined in a U round a low table with tissues and glasses of water. The U opens towards the viewing window.
sofas_velatorio.imagen: Footprint of “Viewing room sofas”: a U open at the front, 3.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Sv”.

tumulo_cristal.descripcion: A big sheet of glass from wall to wall and floor to ceiling: behind it, in a small cold room, is the coffin. From the front it is a smooth wall, icy to the touch; you hear the cooling hum.
tumulo_cristal.imagen: Footprint of “Coffin display behind glass”: a rectangle, 2.60 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

libro_firmas_atril.descripcion: A chest-high wooden stand with a big open book and a pen on a cord, beside the door of the room.
libro_firmas_atril.imagen: Footprint of “Condolence book on a stand”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Lf”.

corona_caballete.descripcion: A big ring of flowers and leaves with a ribbon, resting on an easel with three thin legs. The flowers brush you first, at chest height; the legs catch the cane and it tips over easily.
corona_caballete.imagen: Footprint of “Funeral wreath on an easel”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.90 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

banco_tanatorio.descripcion: A wide, soft backless bench covered in leather, in the corridor outside each room. It gives as you sit and makes no noise.
banco_tanatorio.imagen: Footprint of “Padded funeral home corridor bench”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

carro_feretros.descripcion: A long, narrow metal frame on four wheels at hip height, with rollers on top. Empty, it is nearly all gap: the cane goes in between the legs.
carro_feretros.imagen: Footprint of “Coffin trolley”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

nichos_pared.descripcion: A long, thick wall of four or five rows of niches, each closed with a marble plaque with raised letters and a small vase sticking out. Two blocks make a lane you follow by hand.
nichos_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall of burial niches”: a rectangle, 8.00 by 2.60 metres, marked with the letters “Np”.

columbario.descripcion: A wall of small square compartments for urns, each with a stone plaque or little glass door. The plaques are the size of a floor tile and run from floor to head height.
columbario.imagen: Footprint of “Columbarium”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

tumba_tierra.descripcion: A long stone slab a hand or two above the ground, with an upright stone at the head. Between graves runs a narrow path of earth or gravel.
tumba_tierra.imagen: Footprint of “Grave with headstone”: a long slab with a wider upright headstone at the back, 1.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

panteon.descripcion: A stone hut like a small chapel, with an iron gate for a door and a step in front. The walls are smooth and cold; it echoes inside.
panteon.imagen: Footprint of “Family mausoleum”: a house-shaped pentagon, 3.00 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

cruz_piedra.descripcion: A tall stone cross on a column, set on a base of two or three eight-sided steps. It marks the middle of the cemetery or where its paths cross: the cane meets the steps first.
cruz_piedra.imagen: Footprint of “Stone cross on steps”: an octagon, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

escalera_nichos.descripcion: An iron ladder on wheels with a railed platform on top, for reaching the high niches. People leave it anywhere along the lane; it is heavy and squeals when moved.
escalera_nichos.imagen: Footprint of “Rolling niche ladder”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

fuente_cementerio.descripcion: A stone trough with a tap and, hanging on hooks beside it, plastic watering cans and buckets that sound hollow when brushed. The ground around is often wet.
fuente_cementerio.imagen: Footprint of “Cemetery tap with watering cans”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fc”.

contenedor_flores_secas.descripcion: A big wire-mesh cage, open at the top, for dead flowers and broken pots. It smells of old flowers; the mesh rattles when struck.
contenedor_flores_secas.imagen: Footprint of “Dead flower cage”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

sillon_peluqueria.descripcion: A swivel chair on a heavy round metal base, with a footrest bar in front and a pedal to pump it up. It turns if you lean on an arm.
sillon_peluqueria.imagen: Footprint of “Hydraulic salon chair”: a chair with a narrower footrest sticking out at the front, 0.65 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

sillon_barbero.descripcion: A very heavy iron and leather chair with a headrest, thick arms and a big metal footplate. It tips back with a lever; it stays put.
sillon_barbero.imagen: Footprint of “Barber's chair”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 1.15 metres, marked with the letters “Sb”.

sillon_infantil_coche.descripcion: A little plastic car with a steering wheel and horn mounted on a chair base: children sit in it for a haircut. Low, with rounded edges.
sillon_infantil_coche.imagen: Footprint of “Car-shaped children's salon chair”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Si”.

lavacabezas.descripcion: A fixed, slightly reclined chair with a ceramic basin behind where your neck fits. Behind the basin is the stylist's space; the floor there is often wet.
lavacabezas.imagen: Footprint of “Backwash unit”: a wide basin at the back and a narrower chair in front, 0.65 by 1.25 metres, marked with the letters “La”.

secador_casco.descripcion: A big plastic hood on top of a wheeled stand: you sit under it and it blows hot air with a hum. The hood is at head height and the stand has five star legs.
secador_casco.imagen: Footprint of “Hood dryer on a stand”: a 5-pointed star, 0.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

tocador_peluqueria.descripcion: A big mirror on the wall with a narrow shelf jutting out at waist height, covered in combs, bottles and a dryer on a hook. Nothing underneath: the cane reaches the wall.
tocador_peluqueria.imagen: Footprint of “Styling station with floating shelf”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tp”.

carrito_peluqueria.descripcion: A narrow tower of plastic drawers on wheels, hip high, with rollers, clips and dyes. It is always beside the chair in use: it moves about all day.
carrito_peluqueria.imagen: Footprint of “Salon trolley”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

recepcion_peluqueria.descripcion: A small quarter-circle counter at chest height, tucked in the corner by the door, with the till, the diary and a card reader that beeps.
recepcion_peluqueria.imagen: Footprint of “Salon reception desk”: a quarter circle with its corner at the back left, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

expositor_productos_peluqueria.descripcion: Glass shelves on the wall from chest height to above the head, with rows of shampoo bottles and sprays. The bottles fall if you run your hand along quickly.
expositor_productos_peluqueria.imagen: Footprint of “Hair product display”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ep”.

poste_barbero.descripcion: A glass cylinder the size of a large flask, fixed to the shop front on a bracket beside the barber's door. It is at head height and the cane does not detect it.
poste_barbero.imagen: Footprint of “Revolving barber's pole”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.22 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pb”.

camilla_estetica.descripcion: A wide padded couch with the back raised and a face hole at the head end, covered with a towel. It folds in three sections; there is little room around it.
camilla_estetica.imagen: Footprint of “Beauty treatment couch”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

mesa_manicura.descripcion: A narrow table with a cushion to rest your hand on, a lamp on a flexible arm and an extractor that hums. You on one side and the manicurist on the other, very close.
mesa_manicura.imagen: Footprint of “Manicure table”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.10 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mm”.

sillon_pedicura.descripcion: A tall chair on a plinth with a foot bath in front that bubbles when full. You step up to it; the rim of the bath is at mid-shin height.
sillon_pedicura.imagen: Footprint of “Pedicure chair with foot bath”: a chair with a narrower footrest sticking out at the front, 0.85 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

cabina_rayos_uva.descripcion: A metal cylinder as tall as a door that you step into standing up. With the door shut the fans roar and the wall is warm.
cabina_rayos_uva.imagen: Footprint of “Stand-up tanning booth”: a circle, 1.10 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

lavadora_industrial.descripcion: A steel washing machine twice the size of a home one, with a round glass door at chest height and a thick handle. Several stand in a row; the one running vibrates and you hear the water inside.
lavadora_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Industrial front-loading washer”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Li”.

secadora_industrial_apilada.descripcion: A column of two dryers, one on top of the other, each with a huge round door: the lower at hip height, the upper at face height. It hums, blows warm air and buttons rattle inside.
secadora_industrial_apilada.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked industrial tumble dryer”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Si”.

central_pago_lavanderia.descripcion: A metal box hung on the wall at chest height, with a coin slot, a note reader and a keypad to choose the machine number. The cane passes under it.
central_pago_lavanderia.imagen: Footprint of “Launderette payment terminal”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.25 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cp”.

dispensador_detergente.descripcion: A narrow floor-standing machine with big buttons and a hatch at the bottom where the dose of soap or sachet of softener drops.
dispensador_detergente.imagen: Footprint of “Detergent vending machine”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Dd”.

calandra_planchado.descripcion: A low, very wide machine with a hot roller turning slowly: feed the sheet in at the front and it comes out pressed underneath. The front is hot: keep your hand off the roller.
calandra_planchado.imagen: Footprint of “Flatwork ironer”: a rectangle, 2.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

mesa_doblar_ropa.descripcion: A tall, smooth table at hip height for folding laundry standing up. There is often a shelf of baskets underneath.
mesa_doblar_ropa.imagen: Footprint of “Laundry folding table”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Md”.

carro_ropa_lavanderia.descripcion: A deep wire basket on four swivel wheels, sometimes with a tall rail for hangers. It rolls at the slightest push and is never where you left it.
carro_ropa_lavanderia.imagen: Footprint of “Laundry cart on wheels”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.55 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

banco_lavanderia.descripcion: A long hard plastic bench bolted to the wall facing the machines, with no front legs: the cane goes under it right to the skirting.
banco_lavanderia.imagen: Footprint of “Launderette waiting bench”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

mostrador_tintoreria.descripcion: A wide, smooth waist-high counter where the garment is spread out, with a rail above hung with suits in crackling plastic covers.
mostrador_tintoreria.imagen: Footprint of “Dry cleaner's counter”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

transportador_tintoreria.descripcion: An oval track hung from the ceiling carrying hundreds of hangers with clothes in covers. When it runs, the garments file past and sweep you at face height; the cane gives no warning.
transportador_tintoreria.imagen: Footprint of “Overhead garment conveyor”: an oval, long from front to back, 1.50 by 4.00 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tt”.

prensa_vapor.descripcion: A tongue-shaped padded board at waist height with a matching plate above that comes down on a lever and lets out a puff of steam. The whole edge is hot.
prensa_vapor.imagen: Footprint of “Steam pressing machine”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 1.30 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

cabina_locutorio.descripcion: A narrow numbered chipboard booth with a folding door, in a row with others like it. Inside are a wall phone, a shelf and a stool; you hear muffled voices in several languages.
cabina_locutorio.imagen: Footprint of “Call shop booth”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

puestos_internet_locutorio.descripcion: A long worktop against the wall with a computer every metre and a dividing panel between stations reaching to the edge. You hear typing and the computer fans.
puestos_internet_locutorio.imagen: Footprint of “Internet stations with dividers”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.00 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Pi”.

telefono_pared_orejeras.descripcion: A coin phone hung on the wall between two fins sticking out at head height for privacy. It does not reach the floor: you meet the fins with your shoulder or face.
telefono_pared_orejeras.imagen: Footprint of “Wall payphone with side hoods”: a U open at the front, 0.70 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tp”.

repisa_boletos.descripcion: A narrow shelf screwed to the wall at chest height, with racks of slips and pens on strings. It has no legs: the cane passes under and you find it with your elbow.
repisa_boletos.imagen: Footprint of “Betting slip shelf”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rb”.

terminal_loteria.descripcion: A short chest-high counter with the machine that reads the slips: it whirs, beeps and spits out the receipt. Tickets hang from a string at face height.
terminal_loteria.imagen: Footprint of “Lottery counter with terminal”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.40 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Tl”.

maquina_zapatero.descripcion: A long chest-high machine with a row of sanding rollers and brushes spinning at full speed. Running, it makes a rasping noise and smells of burnt rubber: keep your hands away.
maquina_zapatero.imagen: Footprint of “Cobbler's finishing machine”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mz”.

mostrador_zapatero_llaves.descripcion: A small L-shaped counter covered in shoes, with a key-cutting machine at one end and, behind, a wall of hanging keys that jingle.
mostrador_zapatero_llaves.imagen: Footprint of “Cobbler's counter with key cutter”: an L shape, 1.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mz”.

mostrador_copisteria.descripcion: A long waist-high counter with stacks of paper, a spiral binder and, right behind, several photocopiers working at once. It smells of warm toner.
mostrador_copisteria.imagen: Footprint of “Copy shop counter”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 2.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

guillotina_copisteria.descripcion: An iron table at waist height with a broad blade that comes down when you pull a long lever. The lever sticks up and out into the way at shoulder height.
guillotina_copisteria.imagen: Footprint of “Floor-standing paper guillotine”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

plotter_planos.descripcion: A very wide, low printer on two wheeled legs, with a roll of paper behind and a cloth basket in front to catch the plans. The head runs to and fro with a whir.
plotter_planos.imagen: Footprint of “Large-format plotter”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.
